82044.subject: How Revolut Cut AI Costs 90% and Started Shipping Faster 🚀
82044.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/revolut-ai-coding-costs-open-source-models

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Revolut cut its AI coding bill by 90%. Then its engineers started shipping faster.
David Abitbol, who leads AI operations at Revolut, recently shared this at AI Engineer New York and gave the first inside look at how Revolut runs AI coding at scale. Revolut moved about 2,000 engineers off metered Anthropic and OpenAI APIs. They now use Z.ai’s open-weight GLM model [ https://substack.com/redirect/83a07c33-fc6d-4d06-9a37-082f30bcfd16?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], self-hosted on 56 Nvidia B200 GPUs through Together AI. The blended cost is $0.30 per million tokens, and the invoice is 1/10 of what it was. On top of that, after the switch, lead time (from picking up a feature to merge-ready code) fell by about 70% 😳
Why Revolut’s numbers matter
Who is saying it matters as much as what. A $115 billion secondary share sale in July 2026 made Revolut Europe’s most valuable private company [ https://substack.com/redirect/89f91b13-310d-4743-85f2-f8a416cae321?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. It reported more than $6B of revenue in 2025 [ https://substack.com/redirect/dbdc10c5-cef4-4793-85ab-3e4c54df3d3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], up 46%, from over 80 million customers.
Revolut is also one of the most AI-first fintechs in the world. When a company with that much AI expertise changes how it buys AI, its suppliers, competitors, and investors should take note.
Cheaper AI, faster engineers
Revolut had already given its engineers the best coding agents money could buy, Claude Code and Codex. Yet, delivery speed barely moved. The 90% saving came later, and so did the productivity jump. The link between the two is how AI was priced for the people using it, and most AI companies still get that wrong.
How did Revolut cut AI coding costs by 90%? 🤔 It replaced pay-per-token frontier APIs with a fixed fleet of GPUs running an open-weight model. It tuned that fleet instead of growing it, and kept frontier models for the few tasks that need them.
